messages:
alex: Heads-up — AcmeEdge (HW SI) needs SOC2 report excerpt, latest pen-test report, and questionnaire answers for GCP Marketplace listing. Legal asked for redacted artifacts by Tue EOD. Who can own artifact collection + redaction?

marina: I can start the artifact list. Do we have the exact scoping doc from AcmeEdge? Need to know if firmware attestation is separate.

alex: @marina there's a scoped evidence email from acme@acme.com — I forwarded it. Key asks: SOC2 summary (redact user data), pen-test PDF, vuln scan CSV, SIQ questionnaire.

samir: I can kick off presigned URLs for upload. Will we use the secure courier bucket or partner s3?

jen: Use the courier bucket (partners-evidence-prod) — ops requested TTL 7d and limited IAM. I'll own redaction if security approves.

security-bot: Reminder: upload to partners-evidence-prod must include metadata.json with fields: partner, evidence_type, submitted_by. Failing to include metadata will cause ingestion failure.

matt: tagging infra: @mohammed can you add the IAM role for acme-upload-service? Need write perms for presigns only.

mohammed: will do. I'll create a role with s3:PutObject and kms:Encrypt and presign condition. ETA 2 hrs.

samir: presign snippet I'm going to use:

```
aws s3 presign s3://partners-evidence-prod/acmeedge/2024-11-15/pen-test.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

Also posting CSV template for vuln scan:
```
id,severity,description,remediation
CVE-2024-1234,High,Buffer overflow,patch to 1.2.3
```

marina: For redaction, please label PII in filenames like acme-soc2--redaction-v1.pdf. Jen, what's your preferred workflow? Manual or use redaction pipeline?

jen: Manual for SOC2 and pen PDF (legal wants human review), automated for CSV + questionnaire. I'll spin up a redaction task in Confluence doc and assign.

alex: timeline check: collection today, presigns sent by EOD, uploads by Mon noon, redaction complete by Mon EOD, final bundle to marketplace by Tue EOD. Is that realistic?

jen: tight but ok. I'll need one engineer to review redactions for firmware attestation docs.

mohammed: I can spare @samir for a 1-hr review.

samir: ok.

marina: I'll compile an artifact checklist and share link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/AcmeEdge+Marketplace+Evidence — draft in 15m

alex: thanks. Also legal asked for attestation statement signed by partner. Can someone confirm partner signer? @jen?

jen: Acme said CTO (Elena Ramos). Ask partner to attach signed PDF to same presign path.

matt: small ask: add manifest.json at root of upload with SHA256 checksums. Helps downstream verification.

security-bot: INFO: Evidence ingestion pipeline runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/evidence-ingest — follow vault KMS procedure.

alex: Great. I'll summarize and ping partners. :thumbsup:

marina: summary: owners -> collection: marina; presigns/upload infra: samir/mohammed; redaction/review: jen/samir; manifest/checksum: matt. I'll update Confluence.

jen: adding checklist items for human redaction sign-off.

alex: pinging AcmeEdge now with deadlines and presign expectation. cc: @matt @mohammed @jen @samir :eyes:
